ayahs.ar: طٰسٓمّٓ
ayahs.tl: Taa-Seeen-Meeem
ayahs.en: Ta, Seen, Meem.

ayahs.ar: تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ الۡكِتٰبِ الۡمُبِيۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Tilka Aayaatul Kitaabil mubeen
ayahs.en: These are the verses of the clear Book.

ayahs.ar: نَتۡلُوۡا عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ نَّبَاِ مُوۡسٰي وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ بِالۡحَقِّ لِقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Natloo 'alaika min naba-i Moosaa wa Fi'awna bilhaqqi liqawminy yu'miinoon
ayahs.en: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ فِرۡعَوۡنَ عَلَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَجَعَلَ اَهۡلَهَا شِيَعًا يَّسۡتَضۡعِفُ طَآئِفَةً مِّنۡهُمۡ يُذَبِّحُ اَبۡنَآءَهُمۡ وَيَسۡتَحۡيٖ نِسَآءَهُمۡؕ اِنَّهٗ كَانَ مِنَ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna Fir'awna 'alaa fil ardi wa ja'ala ahlahaa shiya'ai yastad'ifu taaa'ifatam minhum yuzabbihu abnaaa'ahum wa yastahyee nisaaa'ahum; innahoo kaana minal mufsideen
ayahs.en: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters.

ayahs.ar: وَنُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ نَّمُنَّ عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡتُضۡعِفُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَنَجۡعَلَهُمۡ اَئِمَّةً وَّنَجۡعَلَهُمُ الۡوٰرِثِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa nureedu an namunna 'alal lazeenas tud'ifoo fil ardi wa naj'alahum a'immatanw wa naj'alahumul waariseen
ayahs.en: And We wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors

ayahs.ar: وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَنُرِيَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَامٰنَ وَجُنُوۡدَهُمَا مِنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَحۡذَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa numakkina lahum fil ardi wa nuriya Fir'awna wa Haamaana wa junoodahumaa minhum maa kaanoo yahzaroon
ayahs.en: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Haman and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.

ayahs.ar: وَاَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰ٘ي اُمِّ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اَنۡ اَرۡضِعِيۡهِۚ فَاِذَا خِفۡتِ عَلَيۡهِ فَاَلۡقِيۡهِ فِي الۡيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِيۡ وَلَا تَحۡزَنِيۡۚ اِنَّا رَآدُّوۡهُ اِلَيۡكِ وَجَاعِلُوۡهُ مِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa awhainaaa ilaaa ummi Moosaaa an ardi'eehi faizaa khifti 'alaihi fa alqeehi filyammi wa laa takhaafee wa laa tahzaneee innaa raaaddoohu ilaiki wa jaa'iloohu minal mursaleen
ayahs.en: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers."

ayahs.ar: فَالۡتَقَطَهٗ٘ اٰلُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ لِيَكُوۡنَ لَهُمۡ عَدُوًّا وَّحَزَنًاؕ اِنَّ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَامٰنَ وَجُنُوۡدَهُمَا كَانُوۡا خٰطِـِٕيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faltaqatahooo Aalu Fir'awna li yakoona lahum 'aduwwanw wa hazanaa; inna Fir'awna wa Haamaana wa junooda humaa kaanoo khaati'een
ayahs.en: And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief. Indeed, Pharaoh and Haman and their soldiers were deliberate sinners.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَتِ امۡرَاَتُ فِرۡعَوۡنَ قُرَّتُ عَيۡنٍ لِّيۡ وَلَكَؕ لَا تَقۡتُلُوۡهُࣗۖ عَسٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّنۡفَعَنَا٘ اَوۡ نَتَّخِذَهٗ وَلَدًا وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalatim ra atu Fir'awna qurratu 'aynil lee wa lak; laa taqtuloohu 'asaaa aiyanfa'anaa aw nattakhizahoo waladanw wa hum laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: And the wife of Pharaoh said, "[He will be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he may benefit us, or we may adopt him as a son." And they perceived not.

ayahs.ar: وَاَصۡبَحَ فُؤَادُ اُمِّ مُوۡسٰي فٰرِغًاؕ اِنۡ كَادَتۡ لَتُبۡدِيۡ بِهٖ لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ رَّبَطۡنَا عَلٰي قَلۡبِهَا لِتَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa asbaha fu'aadu ummi Moosaa faarighan in kaadat latubdee bihee law laaa arrabatnaa 'alaa qalbihaa litakoona minal mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَتۡ لِاُخۡتِهٖ قُصِّيۡهِؗ فَبَصُرَتۡ بِهٖ عَنۡ جُنُبٍ وَّهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalat li ukhtihee qusseehi fabasurat bihee 'an junubinw wahum laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: And she said to his sister, "Follow him"; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.

ayahs.ar: وَحَرَّمۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ الۡمَرَاضِعَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُ فَقَالَتۡ هَلۡ اَدُلُّكُمۡ عَلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِ بَيۡتٍ يَّكۡفُلُوۡنَهٗ لَكُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهٗ نٰصِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa harramnaa 'alaihil maraadi'a min qablu faqaalat hal adullukum 'alaaa ahli baitiny yakfuloonahoo lakum wa hum lahoo naasihoon
ayahs.en: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"

ayahs.ar: فَرَدَدۡنٰهُ اِلٰ٘ي اُمِّهٖ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَ وَلِتَعۡلَمَ اَنَّ وَعۡدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Faradadnaahu ilaa ummihee kai taqarra 'ainuhaa wa laa tahzana wa lita'lama anna wa'dal laahi haqqunw wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: So We restored him to his mother that she might be content and not grieve and that she would know that the promise of Allah is true. But most of the people do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ اَشُدَّهٗ وَاسۡتَوٰ٘ي اٰتَيۡنٰهُ حُكۡمًا وَّعِلۡمًاؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa balagha ashuddahoo wastawaaa aatai naahu hukmanw wa 'ilmaa; wa kazaalika najzil muhsineen
ayahs.en: And when he attained his full strength and was [mentally] mature, We bestowed upon him judgement and knowledge. And thus do We reward the doers of good.

ayahs.ar: وَدَخَلَ الۡمَدِيۡنَةَ عَلٰي حِيۡنِ غَفۡلَةٍ مِّنۡ اَهۡلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيۡهَا رَجُلَيۡنِ يَقۡتَتِلٰنِؗ هٰذَا مِنۡ شِيۡعَتِهٖ وَهٰذَا مِنۡ عَدُوِّهٖۚ فَاسۡتَغَاثَهُ الَّذِيۡ مِنۡ شِيۡعَتِهٖ عَلَي الَّذِيۡ مِنۡ عَدُوِّهٖۙ فَوَكَزَهٗ مُوۡسٰي فَقَضٰي عَلَيۡهِؗ قَالَ هٰذَا مِنۡ عَمَلِ الشَّيۡطٰنِؕ اِنَّهٗ عَدُوٌّ مُّضِلٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa dakhalal madeenata 'alaa heene ghaflatim min ahlihaa fawajada feeha raju laini yaqtatilaani haazaa min shee'atihee wa haaza min 'aduwwihee fastaghaasahul lazee min shee'atihee 'alal lazee min 'aduwwihee fawakazahoo Moosaa faqadaa 'alaihi qaala haaza min 'amalish Shaitaani innahoo 'aduwwum mmudillum mubeen
ayahs.en: And he entered the city at a time of inattention by its people and found therein two men fighting: one from his faction and one from among his enemy. And the one from his faction called for help to him against the one from his enemy, so Moses struck him and [unintentionally] killed him. [Moses] said, "This is from the work of Satan. Indeed, he is a manifest, misleading enemy."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِيۡ فَاغۡفِرۡ لِيۡ فَغَفَرَ لَهٗؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ الۡغَفُوۡرُ الرَّحِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbi innee zalamtu nafsee faghfir lee faghafaralah; innahoo Huwal Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا٘ اَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيَّ فَلَنۡ اَكُوۡنَ ظَهِيۡرًا لِّلۡمُجۡرِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbi bimaaa an'amta 'alaiya falan akoona zaheeral lilmujrimeen
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."

ayahs.ar: فَاَصۡبَحَ فِي الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ خَآئِفًا يَّتَرَقَّبُ فَاِذَا الَّذِي اسۡتَنۡصَرَهٗ بِالۡاَمۡسِ يَسۡتَصۡرِخُهٗؕ قَالَ لَهٗ مُوۡسٰ٘ي اِنَّكَ لَغَوِيٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Fa asbaha fil madeenati khaaa'ifany yataraqqabu fa izal lazis tansarahoo bil amsi yastasrikhuh; qaala lahoo moosaaa innaka laghawiyyum mubeen
ayahs.en: And he became inside the city fearful and anticipating [exposure], when suddenly the one who sought his help the previous day cried out to him [once again]. Moses said to him, "Indeed, you are an evident, [persistent] deviator."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَنۡ اَرَادَ اَنۡ يَّبۡطِشَ بِالَّذِيۡ هُوَ عَدُوٌّ لَّهُمَاۙ قَالَ يٰمُوۡسٰ٘ي اَتُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ تَقۡتُلَنِيۡ كَمَا قَتَلۡتَ نَفۡسًاۭ بِالۡاَمۡسِࣗ اِنۡ تُرِيۡدُ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ تَكُوۡنَ جَبَّارًا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَمَا تُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ تَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُصۡلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaaa an araada ai yabtisha billazee huwa 'aduwwul lahumaa qaala yaa Moosaaa atureedu an taqtulanee kamaa qatalta nafsam bil amsi in tureedu illaaa an takoona jabbaaram fil ardi wa maa tureedu an takoona minal musliheen
ayahs.en: And when he wanted to strike the one who was an enemy to both of them, he said, "O Moses, do you intend to kill me as you killed someone yesterday? You only want to be a tyrant in the land and do not want to be of the amenders."

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَ رَجُلٌ مِّنۡ اَقۡصَا الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ يَسۡعٰيؗ قَالَ يٰمُوۡسٰ٘ي اِنَّ الۡمَلَاَ يَاۡتَمِرُوۡنَ بِكَ لِيَقۡتُلُوۡكَ فَاخۡرُجۡ اِنِّيۡ لَكَ مِنَ النّٰصِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa jaaa'a rajulum min aqsal madeenati yas'aa qaala yaa Moosaaa innal mala a yaa tamiroona bika liyaqtulooka fakhruj innee laka minan naasiheen
ayahs.en: And a man came from the farthest end of the city, running. He said, "O Moses, indeed the eminent ones are conferring over you [intending] to kill you, so leave [the city]; indeed, I am to you of the sincere advisors."

ayahs.ar: فَخَرَجَ مِنۡهَا خَآئِفًا يَّتَرَقَّبُؗ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِيۡ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fakharaja minhaa khaaa 'ifany-yataraqqab; qaala Rabbi najjinee minal qawmiz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلۡقَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ قَالَ عَسٰي رَبِّيۡ٘ اَنۡ يَّهۡدِيَنِيۡ سَوَآءَ السَّبِيۡلِ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa tawajjaha tilqaaa'a Madyana qaala 'asaa Rabbeee ai yahdiyanee Sawaaa'as Sabeel
ayahs.en: And when he directed himself toward Madyan, he said, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way."

ayahs.ar: وَلَمَّا وَرَدَ مَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ وَجَدَ عَلَيۡهِ اُمَّةً مِّنَ النَّاسِ يَسۡقُوۡنَ ࣢ؗ وَوَجَدَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهِمُ امۡرَاَتَيۡنِ تَذُوۡدٰنِۚ قَالَ مَا خَطۡبُكُمَاؕ قَالَتَا لَا نَسۡقِيۡ حَتّٰي يُصۡدِرَ الرِّعَآءُࣝ وَاَبُوۡنَا شَيۡخٌ كَبِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa lammaa warada maaa'a Madyana wajada 'alaihi ummatam minannaasi yasqoona wa wajada min doonihimum ra ataini tazoodaani qaala maa khatubkumaa qaalataa laa nasqee hataa yusdirar ri'aaa'u wa aboonaa shaikhun kabeer
ayahs.en: And when he came to the well of Madyan, he found there a crowd of people watering [their flocks], and he found aside from them two women driving back [their flocks]. He said, "What is your circumstance?" They said, "We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks]; and our father is an old man."

ayahs.ar: فَسَقٰي لَهُمَا ثُمَّ تَوَلّٰ٘ي اِلَي الظِّلِّ فَقَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ لِمَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡتَ اِلَيَّ مِنۡ خَيۡرٍ فَقِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Fasaqaa lahumaa summa tawallaaa ilaz zilli faqaala Rabbi innee limaaa anzalta ilaiya min khairin faqeer
ayahs.en: So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, "My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need."

ayahs.ar: فَجَآءَتۡهُ اِحۡدٰىهُمَا تَمۡشِيۡ عَلَي اسۡتِحۡيَآءٍؗ قَالَتۡ اِنَّ اَبِيۡ يَدۡعُوۡكَ لِيَجۡزِيَكَ اَجۡرَ مَا سَقَيۡتَ لَنَاؕ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهٗ وَقَصَّ عَلَيۡهِ الۡقَصَصَۙ قَالَ لَا تَخَفۡࣞ نَجَوۡتَ مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fajaaa'at hu ihdaahumaa tamshee 'alas tihyaaa'in qaalat inna abee yad'ooka li yajziyaka ajra maa saqaita lanaa; falammaa jaaa'ahoo wa qassa 'alaihil qasasa qaala laa takhaf najawta minal qawmiz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: Then one of the two women came to him walking with shyness. She said, "Indeed, my father invites you that he may reward you for having watered for us." So when he came to him and related to him the story, he said, "Fear not. You have escaped from the wrongdoing people."

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ اِحۡدٰىهُمَا يٰ٘اَبَتِ اسۡتَاۡجِرۡهُؗ اِنَّ خَيۡرَ مَنِ اسۡتَاۡجَرۡتَ الۡقَوِيُّ الۡاَمِيۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Qaalat ihdaahumaa yaaa abatis taajirhu inna khaira manistaajartal qawiyyul ameen
ayahs.en: One of the women said, "O my father, hire him. Indeed, the best one you can hire is the strong and the trustworthy."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنِّيۡ٘ اُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ اُنۡكِحَكَ اِحۡدَي ابۡنَتَيَّ هٰتَيۡنِ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ تَاۡجُرَنِيۡ ثَمٰنِيَ حِجَجٍۚ فَاِنۡ اَتۡمَمۡتَ عَشۡرًا فَمِنۡ عِنۡدِكَۚ وَمَا٘ اُرِيۡدُ اَنۡ اَشُقَّ عَلَيۡكَؕ سَتَجِدُنِيۡ٘ اِنۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala innee ureedu an unkihaka ihdab nataiya haataini 'alaaa an taajuranee samaaniya hijaj; fa in atmamta 'ashran famin 'indika wa maaa ureedu an ashuqqa 'alaik; satajiduneee in shaaa'al laahu minas saaliheen
ayahs.en: He said, "Indeed, I wish to wed you one of these, my two daughters, on [the condition] that you serve me for eight years; but if you complete ten, it will be [as a favor] from you. And I do not wish to put you in difficulty. You will find me, if Allah wills, from among the righteous."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ ذٰلِكَ بَيۡنِيۡ وَبَيۡنَكَؕ اَيَّمَا الۡاَجَلَيۡنِ قَضَيۡتُ فَلَا عُدۡوَانَ عَلَيَّؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي مَا نَقُوۡلُ وَكِيۡلٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala zaalika bainee wa bainaka aiyamal ajalaini qadaitu falaa 'udwaana 'alaiya wallaahu 'alaa ma naqoolu Wakeel
ayahs.en: [Moses] said, "That is [established] between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I complete - there is no injustice to me, and Allah, over what we say, is Witness."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا قَضٰي مُوۡسَي الۡاَجَلَ وَسَارَ بِاَهۡلِهٖ٘ اٰنَسَ مِنۡ جَانِبِ الطُّوۡرِ نَارًاۚ قَالَ لِاَهۡلِهِ امۡكُثُوۡ٘ا اِنِّيۡ٘ اٰنَسۡتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّيۡ٘ اٰتِيۡكُمۡ مِّنۡهَا بِخَبَرٍ اَوۡ جَذۡوَةٍ مِّنَ النَّارِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَصۡطَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammmaa qadaa Moosal ajala wa saara bi ahliheee aanasa min jaanibit Toori naaran qaala li ahlihim kusooo inneee aanastu naaral la 'alleee aateekum minhaa bikhabarin aw jazwatim minan naari la 'allakum tastaloon
ayahs.en: And when Moses had completed the term and was traveling with his family, he perceived from the direction of the mount a fire. He said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire. Perhaps I will bring you from there [some] information or burning wood from the fire that you may warm yourselves."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَتٰىهَا نُوۡدِيَ مِنۡ شَاطِئِ الۡوَادِ الۡاَيۡمَنِ فِي الۡبُقۡعَةِ الۡمُبٰرَكَةِ مِنَ الشَّجَرَةِ اَنۡ يّٰمُوۡسٰ٘ي اِنِّيۡ٘ اَنَا اللّٰهُ رَبُّ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Falammaaa ataahaa noodiya min shaati'il waadil aimani fil buq'atil muubaarakati minash shajarati ai yaa Moosaaa inneee Anal laahu Rabbul 'aalameen
ayahs.en: But when he came to it, he was called from the right side of the valley in a blessed spot - from the tree, "O Moses, indeed I am Allah, Lord of the worlds."

ayahs.ar: وَاَنۡ اَلۡقِ عَصَاكَؕ فَلَمَّا رَاٰهَا تَهۡتَزُّ كَاَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَّلّٰي مُدۡبِرًا وَّلَمۡ يُعَقِّبۡؕ يٰمُوۡسٰ٘ي اَقۡبِلۡ وَلَا تَخَفۡࣞ اِنَّكَ مِنَ الۡاٰمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa an alqi 'asaaka falam maa ra aahaa tahtazzu ka annnahaa jaaannunw wallaa mudbiranw wa lam yu'aqqib; yaa Moosaa aqbil wa laa takhaf innaka minal aamineen
ayahs.en: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it was a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, approach and fear not. Indeed, you are of the secure.

ayahs.ar: اُسۡلُكۡ يَدَكَ فِيۡ جَيۡبِكَ تَخۡرُجۡ بَيۡضَآءَ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ سُوۡٓءٍؗ وَّاضۡمُمۡ اِلَيۡكَ جَنَاحَكَ مِنَ الرَّهۡبِ فَذٰنِكَ بُرۡهَانٰنِ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ اِلٰي فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَمَلَا۠ئِهٖؕ اِنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا قَوۡمًا فٰسِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Usluk yadaka fee jaibika takhruj baidaaa'a min ghairi sooo'inw wadmum ilaika janaahaka minar rahbi fazaanika burhaanaani mir Rabbika ilaa Fiw'awna wa mala'ih; innahum kaanoo qawman faasiqeen
ayahs.en: Insert your hand into the opening of your garment; it will come out white, without disease. And draw in your arm close to you [as prevention] from fear, for those are two proofs from your Lord to Pharaoh and his establishment. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ قَتَلۡتُ مِنۡهُمۡ نَفۡسًا فَاَخَافُ اَنۡ يَّقۡتُلُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbi innee qataltu minhum nafsan fa akhaafu ai yaqtuloon
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed, I killed from among them someone, and I fear they will kill me.

ayahs.ar: وَاَخِيۡ هٰرُوۡنُ هُوَ اَفۡصَحُ مِنِّيۡ لِسَانًا فَاَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعِيَ رِدۡاً يُّصَدِّقُنِيۡ٘ؗ اِنِّيۡ٘ اَخَافُ اَنۡ يُّكَذِّبُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Wa akhee Haaroonu huwa afsahu minnee lisaanan fa arsilhu ma'iya rid ai yusaddiquneee innee akhaafu ai yukazziboon
ayahs.en: And my brother Aaron is more fluent than me in tongue, so send him with me as support, verifying me. Indeed, I fear that they will deny me."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ سَنَشُدُّ عَضُدَكَ بِاَخِيۡكَ وَنَجۡعَلُ لَكُمَا سُلۡطٰنًا فَلَا يَصِلُوۡنَ اِلَيۡكُمَاۛۚ بِاٰيٰتِنَاۛۚ اَنۡتُمَا وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَكُمَا الۡغٰلِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala sanashuddu 'adudaka bi akheeka wa naj'alu lakumaa sultaanan falaa yasiloona ilaikumaa; bi Aayaatinaa antumaa wa manit taba'akumal ghaaliboon
ayahs.en: [Allah] said, "We will strengthen your arm through your brother and grant you both supremacy so they will not reach you. [It will be] through Our signs; you and those who follow you will be the predominant."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ مُّوۡسٰي بِاٰيٰتِنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ قَالُوۡا مَا هٰذَا٘ اِلَّا سِحۡرٌ مُّفۡتَرًي وَّمَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهٰذَا فِيۡ٘ اٰبَآئِنَا الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'ahum Moosaa bi Aayaatinaa baiyinaatin qaaloo maa haazaaa illaa sihrum muftaranw wa maa sami'naa bihaazaa feee aabaaa'inal awwaleen
ayahs.en: But when Moses came to them with Our signs as clear evidences, they said, "This is not except invented magic, and we have not heard of this [religion] among our forefathers."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ مُوۡسٰي رَبِّيۡ٘ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ جَآءَ بِالۡهُدٰي مِنۡ عِنۡدِهٖ وَمَنۡ تَكُوۡنُ لَهٗ عَاقِبَةُ الدَّارِؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُفۡلِحُ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala Moosaa Rabbeee a'alamu biman jaaa'a bilhudaa min 'indihee wa man takoonu lahoo 'aaqibatud daari innahoo laa yuflihuz zaalimoon
ayahs.en: And Moses said, "My Lord is more knowing [than we or you] of who has come with guidance from Him and to whom will be succession in the home. Indeed, wrongdoers do not succeed."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الۡمَلَاُ مَا عَلِمۡتُ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اِلٰهٍ غَيۡرِيۡۚ فَاَوۡقِدۡ لِيۡ يٰهَامٰنُ عَلَي الطِّيۡنِ فَاجۡعَلۡ لِّيۡ صَرۡحًا لَّعَلِّيۡ٘ اَطَّلِعُ اِلٰ٘ي اِلٰهِ مُوۡسٰيۙ وَاِنِّيۡ لَاَظُنُّهٗ مِنَ الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaala Fir'awnu yaaa aiyuhal mala-u maa 'alimtu lakum min ilaahin ghairee fa awqid lee yaa Haamaanu 'alatteeni faj'al lee sarhal la'alleee attali'u ilaaa ilaahi Moosaa wa innee la azunnuhoo minal kaazibeen
ayahs.en: And Pharaoh said, "O eminent ones, I have not known you to have a god other than me. Then ignite for me, O Haman, [a fire] upon the clay and make for me a tower that I may look at the God of Moses. And indeed, I do think he is among the liars."

ayahs.ar: وَاسۡتَكۡبَرَ هُوَ وَجُنُوۡدُهٗ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ بِغَيۡرِ الۡحَقِّ وَظَنُّوۡ٘ا اَنَّهُمۡ اِلَيۡنَا لَا يُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wastakbara huwa wa junooduhoo fil ardi bighairil haqqi wa zannooo annahum ilainaa laa yurja'oon
ayahs.en: And he was arrogant, he and his soldiers, in the land, without right, and they thought that they would not be returned to Us.

ayahs.ar: فَاَخَذۡنٰهُ وَجُنُوۡدَهٗ فَنَبَذۡنٰهُمۡ فِي الۡيَمِّۚ فَانۡظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa akhaznaahu wa junoo dahoo fanabaznaahum fil yammi fanzur kaifa kaana 'aaqibatuz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: So We took him and his soldiers and threw them into the sea. So see how was the end of the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلۡنٰهُمۡ اَئِمَّةً يَّدۡعُوۡنَ اِلَي النَّارِۚ وَيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ لَا يُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'alnaahum a'immatany yad'oona ilan Naari wa Yawmal Qiyaamati laa yunsaroon
ayahs.en: And We made them leaders inviting to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.

ayahs.ar: وَاَتۡبَعۡنٰهُمۡ فِيۡ هٰذِهِ الدُّنۡيَا لَعۡنَةًۚ وَيَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ هُمۡ مِّنَ الۡمَقۡبُوۡحِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa atba'naahum fee haazihid dunyaa la'natanw wa Yawmal Qiyaamati hum minal maqbooheen
ayahs.en: And We caused to overtake them in this world a curse, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be of the despised.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اٰتَيۡنَا مُوۡسَي الۡكِتٰبَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا٘ اَهۡلَكۡنَا الۡقُرُوۡنَ الۡاُوۡلٰي بَصَآئِرَ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةً لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad aatainaa Moosal Kitaaba mim ba'di maaa ahlaknal quroonal oolaa basaaa'ira linnaasi wa hudanw wa rahmatal la'allahum yata zakkkaroon
ayahs.en: And We gave Moses the Scripture, after We had destroyed the former generations, as enlightenment for the people and guidance and mercy that they might be reminded.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كُنۡتَ بِجَانِبِ الۡغَرۡبِيِّ اِذۡ قَضَيۡنَا٘ اِلٰي مُوۡسَي الۡاَمۡرَ وَمَا كُنۡتَ مِنَ الشّٰهِدِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kunta bijaanibil gharbiyyi iz qadainaaa ilaa Moosal amra wa maa kunta minash shaahideen
ayahs.en: And you, [O Muhammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when We revealed to Moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that].

ayahs.ar: وَلٰكِنَّا٘ اَنۡشَاۡنَا قُرُوۡنًا فَتَطَاوَلَ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡعُمُرُۚ وَمَا كُنۡتَ ثَاوِيًا فِيۡ٘ اَهۡلِ مَدۡيَنَ تَتۡلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتِنَاۙ وَلٰكِنَّا كُنَّا مُرۡسِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laakinnaa anshaanaa quroonan fatataawala 'alaihimul 'umur; wa maa kunta saawiyan feee ahli Madyana tatloo 'alaihim Aayaatinaa wa laakinnaa kunnaa mursileen
ayahs.en: But We produced [many] generations [after Moses], and prolonged was their duration. And you were not a resident among the people of Madyan, reciting to them Our verses, but We were senders [of this message].

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كُنۡتَ بِجَانِبِ الطُّوۡرِ اِذۡ نَادَيۡنَا وَلٰكِنۡ رَّحۡمَةً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ لِتُنۡذِرَ قَوۡمًا مَّا٘ اَتٰىهُمۡ مِّنۡ نَّذِيۡرٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kunta bijaanibit Toori iz naadainaa wa laakir rahmatam mir Rabbika litunzira qawmam maaa ataahum min nazeerim min qablika la'allahum yatazakkaroon
ayahs.en: And you were not at the side of the mount when We called [Moses] but [were sent] as a mercy from your Lord to warn a people to whom no warner had come before you that they might be reminded.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ تُصِيۡبَهُمۡ مُّصِيۡبَةٌۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ فَيَقُوۡلُوۡا رَبَّنَا لَوۡلَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡتَ اِلَيۡنَا رَسُوۡلًا فَنَتَّبِعَ اٰيٰتِكَ وَنَكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law laaa an tuseebahum museebatum bimaa qaddamat aideehim fa yaqooloo Rabbanaa law laaa arsalta ilainaa Rasoolan fanattabi'a Aayaatika wa nakoona minal mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And if not that a disaster should strike them for what their hands put forth [of sins] and they would say, "Our Lord, why did You not send us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses and been among the believers?"...

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ عِنۡدِنَا قَالُوۡا لَوۡلَا٘ اُوۡتِيَ مِثۡلَ مَا٘ اُوۡتِيَ مُوۡسٰيؕ اَوَلَمۡ يَكۡفُرُوۡا بِمَا٘ اُوۡتِيَ مُوۡسٰي مِنۡ قَبۡلُۚ قَالُوۡا سِحۡرٰنِ تَظَاهَرَاࣞ وَقَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا بِكُلٍّ كٰفِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa jaaa'ahumul haqqu min 'indinaa qaaloo law laa ootiya misla maaa ootiyaa Moosaa; awalam yakfuroo bimaaa ootiya Moosaa min qablu qaaloo sihraani tazaaharaa wa qaalooo innaa bikullin kaafiroon
ayahs.en: But when the truth came to them from Us, they said, "Why was he not given like that which was given to Moses?" Did they not disbelieve in that which was given to Moses before? They said, "[They are but] two works of magic supporting each other, and indeed we are, in both, disbelievers."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ فَاۡتُوۡا بِكِتٰبٍ مِّنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِ هُوَ اَهۡدٰي مِنۡهُمَا٘ اَتَّبِعۡهُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul faatoo bi Kitaabim min 'indil laahi huwa ahdaa minhu maaa attabi'hu in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: Say, "Then bring a scripture from Allah which is more guiding than either of them that I may follow it, if you should be truthful."

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ لَّمۡ يَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لَكَ فَاعۡلَمۡ اَنَّمَا يَتَّبِعُوۡنَ اَهۡوَآءَهُمۡؕ وَمَنۡ اَضَلُّ مِمَّنِ اتَّبَعَ هَوٰىهُ بِغَيۡرِ هُدًي مِّنَ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِي الۡقَوۡمَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa il lam yastajeeboo laka fa'lam annamaa yattabi'oona ahwaaa'ahum; w aman adallu mimmanit taba'a hawaahu bighari hudam minal laah; innal laaha laa yahdil qawmaz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: But if they do not respond to you - then know that they only follow their [own] desires. And who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from Allah? Indeed, Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ وَصَّلۡنَا لَهُمُ الۡقَوۡلَ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad wassalnaa lahumul qawla la'allahum yatazakkaroon
ayahs.en: And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the Qur'an that they might be reminded.

ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمُ الۡكِتٰبَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ هُمۡ بِهٖ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena aatainaahu mul Kitaaba min qablihee hum bihee yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Those to whom We gave the Scripture before it - they are believers in it.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا يُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّا بِهٖ٘ اِنَّهُ الۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّنَا٘ اِنَّا كُنَّا مِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ مُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa yutlaa 'alaihim qaaloo aamannaa biheee innahul haqqu mir rabbinaaa innaa kunnaa min qablihee muslimeen
ayahs.en: And when it is recited to them, they say, "We have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our Lord. Indeed we were, [even] before it, Muslims [submitting to Allah]."

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ يُؤۡتَوۡنَ اَجۡرَهُمۡ مَّرَّتَيۡنِ بِمَا صَبَرُوۡا وَيَدۡرَءُوۡنَ بِالۡحَسَنَةِ السَّيِّئَةَ وَمِمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡ يُنۡفِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ika yu'tawna ajrahum marratayni bimaa sabaroo wa yadra'oona bil hasanatis saiyi'ata wa mimmmaa razaq naahum yunfiqoon
ayahs.en: Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا سَمِعُوا اللَّغۡوَ اَعۡرَضُوۡا عَنۡهُ وَقَالُوۡا لَنَا٘ اَعۡمَالُنَا وَلَكُمۡ اَعۡمَالُكُمۡؗ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡؗ لَا نَبۡتَغِي الۡجٰهِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa sami'ul laghwa a'radoo 'anhu wa qaaloo lanaaa a'maalunaa wa lakum a'maalukum salaamun 'alaikum laa nabtaghil jaahileen
ayahs.en: And when they hear ill speech, they turn away from it and say, "For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. Peace will be upon you; we seek not the ignorant."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكَ لَا تَهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ اَحۡبَبۡتَ وَلٰكِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُۚ وَهُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِالۡمُهۡتَدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innaka laa tahdee man ahbata wa laakinna laaha yahdee mai yashaaa'; wa Huwaa'lamu bilmuhtadeen
ayahs.en: Indeed, [O Muhammad], you do not guide whom you like, but Allah guides whom He wills. And He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ نَّتَّبِعِ الۡهُدٰي مَعَكَ نُتَخَطَّفۡ مِنۡ اَرۡضِنَاؕ اَوَلَمۡ نُمَكِّنۡ لَّهُمۡ حَرَمًا اٰمِنًا يُّجۡبٰ٘ي اِلَيۡهِ ثَمَرٰتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ رِّزۡقًا مِّنۡ لَّدُنَّا وَلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalooo in nattabi'il hudaa ma'aka nutakhattaf min ardinaa; awalam numakkkil lahum haraman aaminany yujbaaa ilaihi samaraatu kulli shai'ir rizqam mil ladunnaa wa laakinna aksarahum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And they say, "If we were to follow the guidance with you, we would be swept from our land." Have we not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from Us? But most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَكَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا مِنۡ قَرۡيَةٍۭ بَطِرَتۡ مَعِيۡشَتَهَاۚ فَتِلۡكَ مَسٰكِنُهُمۡ لَمۡ تُسۡكَنۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِهِمۡ اِلَّا قَلِيۡلًاؕ وَكُنَّا نَحۡنُ الۡوٰرِثِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa kam ahlaknaa min qaryatim batirat ma'eeshatahaa fatilka masaainuhum lam tuskam mim ba'dihim illaa qaleelaa; wa kunnaa Nahnul waariseen
ayahs.en: And how many a city have We destroyed that was insolent in its [way of] living, and those are their dwellings which have not been inhabited after them except briefly. And it is We who were the inheritors.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ مُهۡلِكَ الۡقُرٰي حَتّٰي يَبۡعَثَ فِيۡ٘ اُمِّهَا رَسُوۡلًا يَّتۡلُوۡا عَلَيۡهِمۡ اٰيٰتِنَاۚ وَمَا كُنَّا مُهۡلِكِي الۡقُرٰ٘ي اِلَّا وَاَهۡلُهَا ظٰلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kaana Rabbuka muhlikal quraa hattaa yab'asa feee ummihaa Rasoolany yatloo 'alaihim aayaatina; wa maa kunnaa muhlikil quraaa illaa wa ahluhaa zaalimoon
ayahs.en: And never would your Lord have destroyed the cities until He had sent to their mother a messenger reciting to them Our verses. And We would not destroy the cities except while their people were wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اُوۡتِيۡتُمۡ مِّنۡ شَيۡءٍ فَمَتَاعُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا وَزِيۡنَتُهَاۚ وَمَا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ خَيۡرٌ وَّاَبۡقٰيؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa ooteetum min shai'in famataa'ul hayaatid dunyaa wa zeenatuhaa; wa maa 'indal laahi khairunw wa abqaa; afalaa ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: And whatever thing you [people] have been given - it is [only for] the enjoyment of worldly life and its adornment. And what is with Allah is better and more lasting; so will you not use reason?

ayahs.ar: اَفَمَنۡ وَّعَدۡنٰهُ وَعۡدًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ لَاقِيۡهِ كَمَنۡ مَّتَّعۡنٰهُ مَتَاعَ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا ثُمَّ هُوَ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ مِنَ الۡمُحۡضَرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Afamanw wa'adnaahu wa'dan hasanan fahuwa laaqeehi kamam matta'naahu mataa'al hayaatid dunyaa summa huwa Yawmal Qiyaamati minal muhdareen
ayahs.en: Then is he whom We have promised a good promise which he will obtain like he for whom We provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the Day of Resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in Hell]?

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيۡهِمۡ فَيَقُوۡلُ اَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ كُنۡتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Yawma yunaadeehim fa-yaqoolu aina shurakaaa 'iyal lazeena kuntum taz'umoon
ayahs.en: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are My 'partners' which you used to claim?"

ayahs.ar: قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ حَقَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡقَوۡلُ رَبَّنَا هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ الَّذِيۡنَ اَغۡوَيۡنَاۚ اَغۡوَيۡنٰهُمۡ كَمَا غَوَيۡنَاۚ تَبَرَّاۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَؗ مَا كَانُوۡ٘ا اِيَّانَا يَعۡبُدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaalal lazeena haqqa 'alaihimul qawlu Rabbanaa haaa'ulaaa'il lazeena aghwainaa aghwainaahu kamaa ghawainaa tabarraanaaa ilaika maa kaanoo iyyaanaa ya'budoon
ayahs.en: Those upon whom the word will have come into effect will say, "Our Lord, these are the ones we led to error. We led them to error just as we were in error. We declare our disassociation [from them] to You. They did not used to worship us."

ayahs.ar: وَقِيۡلَ ادۡعُوۡا شُرَكَآءَكُمۡ فَدَعَوۡهُمۡ فَلَمۡ يَسۡتَجِيۡبُوۡا لَهُمۡ وَرَاَوُا الۡعَذَابَۚ لَوۡ اَنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qeelad 'oo shurakaaa'akum fada'awhum falam yastajeeboo lahum wa ra awul 'azaab; law annahum kaanoo yahtadoon
ayahs.en: And it will be said, "Invoke your 'partners' " and they will invoke them; but they will not respond to them, and they will see the punishment. If only they had followed guidance!

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيۡهِمۡ فَيَقُوۡلُ مَاذَا٘ اَجَبۡتُمُ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Yawma yunaadeehim fa yaqoolu maazaaa ajabtumul mursaleen
ayahs.en: And [mention] the Day He will call them and say, "What did you answer the messengers?"

ayahs.ar: فَعَمِيَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡاَنۭۡ بَآءُ يَوۡمَئِذٍ فَهُمۡ لَا يَتَسَآءَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa'amiyat 'alaihimul ambaaa'u Yawma'izin fahum laa yatasaaa'aloon
ayahs.en: But the information will be unapparent to them that Day, so they will not [be able to] ask one another.

ayahs.ar: فَاَمَّا مَنۡ تَابَ وَاٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَعَسٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّكُوۡنَ مِنَ الۡمُفۡلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa ammaa man taaba wa aamana wa 'amila saalihan fa'asaaa ai yakoona minal mufliheen
ayahs.en: But as for one who had repented, believed, and done righteousness, it is promised by Allah that he will be among the successful.

ayahs.ar: وَرَبُّكَ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيَخۡتَارُؕ مَا كَانَ لَهُمُ الۡخِيَرَةُؕ سُبۡحٰنَ اللّٰهِ وَتَعٰلٰي عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Rabbuka yakhuluqu maa yashaaa'u wa yakhtaar; maa kaana lahumul khiyarah; Subhannal laahi wa Ta'aalaa 'ammmaa yushrikoon
ayahs.en: And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses; not for them was the choice. Exalted is Allah and high above what they associate with Him.

ayahs.ar: وَرَبُّكَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُوۡرُهُمۡ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Rabbuka ya'lamu maa tukinnu sudooruhum wa maa yu'linoon
ayahs.en: And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ اللّٰهُ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَؕ لَهُ الۡحَمۡدُ فِي الۡاُوۡلٰي وَالۡاٰخِرَةِؗ وَلَهُ الۡحُكۡمُ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal laahu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwa lahul hamdu fil oolaa wal Aakhirati wa lahul hukmu wa ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.en: And He is Allah; there is no deity except Him. To Him is [due all] praise in the first [life] and the Hereafter. And His is the [final] decision, and to Him you will be returned.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ جَعَلَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡكُمُ الَّيۡلَ سَرۡمَدًا اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ مَنۡ اِلٰهٌ غَيۡرُ اللّٰهِ يَاۡتِيۡكُمۡ بِضِيَآءٍؕ اَفَلَا تَسۡمَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul ara'aitum in ja'alal laahu 'alaikumul laila sarmadan ilaa Yawmil Qiyaamati man ilaahun ghairul laahi yaa teekum bidiyaaa'in afalaa tasma'oon
ayahs.en: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should make for you the night continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allah could bring you light? Then will you not hear?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَرَءَيۡتُمۡ اِنۡ جَعَلَ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡكُمُ النَّهَارَ سَرۡمَدًا اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِ مَنۡ اِلٰهٌ غَيۡرُ اللّٰهِ يَاۡتِيۡكُمۡ بِلَيۡلٍ تَسۡكُنُوۡنَ فِيۡهِؕ اَفَلَا تُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul ara'aitum in ja'alal laahu 'alaikumun nahaara sarmadan ilaa Yawmil Qiyaamati man ilaahun ghairul laahi yaateekum bilailin taskunoona feehi afalaa tubsiroon
ayahs.en: Say, "Have you considered: if Allah should make for you the day continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than Allah could bring you a night in which you may rest? Then will you not see?"

ayahs.ar: وَمِنۡ رَّحۡمَتِهٖ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَ لِتَسۡكُنُوۡا فِيۡهِ وَلِتَبۡتَغُوۡا مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa mir rahmatihee ja'ala lakumul laila wannahaara litaskunoo feehi wa litabtaghoo min fadlihee wa la'allakum tashkuroon
ayahs.en: And out of His mercy He made for you the night and the day that you may rest therein and [by day] seek from His bounty and [that] perhaps you will be grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيۡهِمۡ فَيَقُوۡلُ اَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ كُنۡتُمۡ تَزۡعُمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Yawma yunaadeehim fa yaqoolu aina shurakaaa'iyal lazeena kuntum tazz'umoon
ayahs.en: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, "Where are my 'partners' which you used to claim?"

ayahs.ar: وَنَزَعۡنَا مِنۡ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ شَهِيۡدًا فَقُلۡنَا هَاتُوۡا بُرۡهَانَكُمۡ فَعَلِمُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ الۡحَقَّ لِلّٰهِ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa naza'naa min kulli ummatin shaheedan faqulnaa haatoo burhaanakum fa'alimooo annal haqqa lillaahi wa dalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
ayahs.en: And We will extract from every nation a witness and say, "Produce your proof," and they will know that the truth belongs to Allah, and lost from them is that which they used to invent.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ قَارُوۡنَ كَانَ مِنۡ قَوۡمِ مُوۡسٰي فَبَغٰي عَلَيۡهِمۡࣕ وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ مِنَ الۡكُنُوۡزِ مَا٘ اِنَّ مَفَاتِحَهٗ لَتَنُوۡٓاُ بِالۡعُصۡبَةِ اُولِي الۡقُوَّةِࣗ اِذۡ قَالَ لَهٗ قَوۡمُهٗ لَا تَفۡرَحۡ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡفَرِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Inna Qaaroona kaana min qawmi Moosaa fabaghaaa 'alaihim wa aatainaahu minal kunoozi maaa inna mafaati hahoo latanooo'u bil'usbati ulil quwwati iz qaala lahoo qawmuhoo laa tafrah innal laahaa laa yuhibbul fariheen
ayahs.en: Indeed, Qarun was from the people of Moses, but he tyrannized them. And We gave him of treasures whose keys would burden a band of strong men; thereupon his people said to him, "Do not exult. Indeed, Allah does not like the exultant.

ayahs.ar: وَابۡتَغِ فِيۡمَا٘ اٰتٰىكَ اللّٰهُ الدَّارَ الۡاٰخِرَةَ وَلَا تَنۡسَ نَصِيۡبَكَ مِنَ الدُّنۡيَا وَاَحۡسِنۡ كَمَا٘ اَحۡسَنَ اللّٰهُ اِلَيۡكَ وَلَا تَبۡغِ الۡفَسَادَ فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wabtaghi feemaaa aataakal laahud Daaral Aakhirata wa laa tansa naseebaka minad dunyaa wa ahsin kamaaa ahsanal laahu ilaika wa laa tabghil fasaada fil ardi innal laaha laa yuhibbul mufsideen
ayahs.en: But seek, through that which Allah has given you, the home of the Hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world. And do good as Allah has done good to you. And desire not corruption in the land. Indeed, Allah does not like corrupters."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ اِنَّمَا٘ اُوۡتِيۡتُهٗ عَلٰي عِلۡمٍ عِنۡدِيۡؕ اَوَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمۡ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ قَدۡ اَهۡلَكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهٖ مِنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ مَنۡ هُوَ اَشَدُّ مِنۡهُ قُوَّةً وَّاَكۡثَرُ جَمۡعًاؕ وَلَا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَنۡ ذُنُوۡبِهِمُ الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaala innamaaa ootee tuhoo 'alaa 'ilmin 'indeee; awalam ya'lam annal laaha qad ahlaka min qablihee minal qurooni man huwa ashaddu minhu quwwatanw wa aksaru jam'aa; wa laa yus'alu 'an zunoobihimul mujrimoon
ayahs.en: He said, "I was only given it because of knowledge I have." Did he not know that Allah had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? But the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked.

ayahs.ar: فَخَرَجَ عَلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ فِيۡ زِيۡنَتِهٖؕ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَا يٰلَيۡتَ لَنَا مِثۡلَ مَا٘ اُوۡتِيَ قَارُوۡنُۙ اِنَّهٗ لَذُوۡ حَظٍّ عَظِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Fakharaja 'alaa qawmihee fee zeenatih; qaalal lazeena yureedoonal hayaatad dunyaa yaalaita lanaa misla maaa ootiya Qaaroonu innahoo lazoo hazzin 'azeem
ayahs.en: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qarun. Indeed, he is one of great fortune."

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡعِلۡمَ وَيۡلَكُمۡ ثَوَابُ اللّٰهِ خَيۡرٌ لِّمَنۡ اٰمَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَالِحًاۚ وَلَا يُلَقّٰىهَا٘ اِلَّا الصّٰبِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena ootul 'ilma wailakum sawaabul laahi khairul liman aamana wa 'amila saalihaa; wa laa yulaq qaahaaa illas saabiroon
ayahs.en: But those who had been given knowledge said, "Woe to you! The reward of Allah is better for he who believes and does righteousness. And none are granted it except the patient."

ayahs.ar: فَخَسَفۡنَا بِهٖ وَبِدَارِهِ الۡاَرۡضَࣞ فَمَا كَانَ لَهٗ مِنۡ فِئَةٍ يَّنۡصُرُوۡنَهٗ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِࣗؗ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الۡمُنۡتَصِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fakhasafnaa bihee wa bidaarihil arda famaa kaana laho min fi'atiny yansuroo nahoo min doonil laahi wa maa kaana minal muntasireen
ayahs.en: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves.

ayahs.ar: وَاَصۡبَحَ الَّذِيۡنَ تَمَنَّوۡا مَكَانَهٗ بِالۡاَمۡسِ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ وَيۡكَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَبۡسُطُ الرِّزۡقَ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ مَّنَّ اللّٰهُ عَلَيۡنَا لَخَسَفَ بِنَاؕ وَيۡكَاَنَّهٗ لَا يُفۡلِحُ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa asbahal lazeena tamannaw makaanahoo bil amsi yaqooloona waika annal laaha yabsutur rizqa limany ya shaaa'u min 'ibaadihee wa yaqdiru law laaa am mannal laahu 'alainaa lakhasafa binaa waika annahoo laa yuflihul kaafiroon
ayahs.en: And those who had wished for his position the previous day began to say, "Oh, how Allah extends provision to whom He wills of His servants and restricts it! If not that Allah had conferred favor on us, He would have caused it to swallow us. Oh, how the disbelievers do not succeed!"

ayahs.ar: تِلۡكَ الدَّارُ الۡاٰخِرَةُ نَجۡعَلُهَا لِلَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُرِيۡدُوۡنَ عُلُوًّا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا فَسَادًاؕ وَالۡعَاقِبَةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Tilkad Daarul Aakhiratu naj'aluhaa lillazeena laa yureedoona 'uluwwan fil ardi wa laa fasaadaa; wal 'aaqibatu lilmuttaqeen
ayahs.en: That home of the Hereafter We assign to those who do not desire exaltedness upon the earth or corruption. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous.

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ جَآءَ بِالۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهٗ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡهَاۚ وَمَنۡ جَآءَ بِالسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجۡزَي الَّذِيۡنَ عَمِلُوا السَّيِّاٰتِ اِلَّا مَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Man jaaa'a bilhasanati falahoo khairum minhaa wa man jaaa'a bissaiyi'ati falaa yujzal lazeena 'amilus saiyiaati illaa maa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it; and whoever comes with an evil deed - then those who did evil deeds will not be recompensed except [as much as] what they used to do.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡ فَرَضَ عَلَيۡكَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ لَرَآدُّكَ اِلٰي مَعَادٍؕ قُلۡ رَّبِّيۡ٘ اَعۡلَمُ مَنۡ جَآءَ بِالۡهُدٰي وَمَنۡ هُوَ فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Innal azee farada 'alaikal Qur-aana laraaadduka ilaa ma'aad; qur Rabbeee a'lamu man jjaaa'a bil hudaa wa man huwa fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.en: Indeed, [O Muhammad], He who imposed upon you the Qur'an will take you back to a place of return. Say, "My Lord is most knowing of who brings guidance and who is in clear error."

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كُنۡتَ تَرۡجُوۡ٘ا اَنۡ يُّلۡقٰ٘ي اِلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبُ اِلَّا رَحۡمَةً مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُوۡنَنَّ ظَهِيۡرًا لِّلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَؗ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kunta tarjooo ai yulqaaa ilaikal Kitaabu illaa rahmatam mir Rabbika falaa takoonanna zaheeral lilkaafireen
ayahs.en: And you were not expecting that the Book would be conveyed to you, but [it is] a mercy from your Lord. So do not be an assistant to the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَصُدُّنَّكَ عَنۡ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ بَعۡدَ اِذۡ اُنۡزِلَتۡ اِلَيۡكَ وَادۡعُ اِلٰي رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُوۡنَنَّ مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa yasuddunnaka 'an Aayaatil laahi ba'da iz unzilat ilaika wad'u ilaa Rabbika wa laa takonanna minal mushrikeen
ayahs.en: And never let them avert you from the verses of Allah after they have been revealed to you. And invite [people] to your Lord. And never be of those who associate others with Allah.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۘ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَࣞ كُلُّ شَيۡءٍ هَالِكٌ اِلَّا وَجۡهَهٗؕ لَهُ الۡحُكۡمُ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tad'u ma'al laahi ilaahan aakhar; laaa ilaaha illaa Hoo; kullu shai'in haalikun illaa Wajhah; lahul hukkmu wa ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.en: And do not invoke with Allah another deity. There is no deity except Him. Everything will be destroyed except His Face. His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned.
